purpose: v1.0 critical audit — distinguish source_platform vs original_publisher per spec.
boundary_note: 书格 (shuge.org) is a digital-photograph hosting platform that catalogs National Diet Library (Japan) and other public-domain scans. It is NOT the original publisher of the classical works it hosts. Original publishers/authorship of pre-modern Chinese classics are usually unknown, anonymous, or pre-print. This file preserves that audit without modifying v0.7 bibliography.json.

institution_roles.role_correction_v1.0: 书格 is a digital-photograph source_platform that hosts scanned page images of pre-modern Chinese classics held by National Diet Library (国立公文書館, Japan) and similar public-domain archives. It is NOT the original publisher of 《水经注》 (Northern Wei / 6th c.) or 《天工开物》 (Song / 1637) or 《工程做法》 (Qing / 1734). The original authorship/publisher of these pre-modern works is unknown or pre-print, and is NOT shuge.org.
what_shuge_provides: OCR text snippets (char_count, mean_confidence per page)
what_shuge_does_NOT_provide: Editorial authority over the classical text
institution_roles.url_role: Read-only ID reference. No content fetched. No scraping.
institution_roles.audit_status: CRITICAL CORRECTION — v0.7 typed 'publisher'; v1.0 corrects to 'source_platform' for the v1.0 article and ALL future references.
institution_roles.audit_warning: Spec v1.0 §7: 不得把 source platform 错当 publisher. ALL v1.0 article text MUST use '书格' as 'source platform' / 'hosting platform', never 'publisher'.

institution_roles.what_it_provides: The actual physical scanned volumes that shuge.org photographs from. Many work_ids (p124575, p211203, p44159, p48341) are derived from 国立公文書館 scans (visible in text_preview: '国立公文書館', 'Natio', '内阁文库').
institution_roles.referenced_as: archive of origin (where shuge photographs from)
institution_roles.note: Not fetched, not linked. ID-only reference.

institution_roles.what_it_provides: The historical authorship of the classical texts (郦道元 / Song Yingxing / Qing 工部). Pre-modern works frequently have unknown or anonymous publishers.
institution_roles.referenced_as: author / era attribution in dynasty field (Northern Wei / Song / Qing)
institution_roles.note: v0.7 bibliography captures `dynasty` field per work. v1.0 article uses dynasty for era attribution.

archive_bridge_invariants_v1_0.text: v1.0 article MUST reference 书格 only as 'source platform' / 'digital photograph hosting platform', NEVER as 'publisher'.
v1.0 article MUST use `dynasty` field for era attribution (e.g., 'Northern Wei', 'Song', 'Qing'), NOT for publisher attribution.
v1.0 article MUST cite original authorship where known (e.g., 郦道元 for 《水经注》, 宋应星 for 《天工开物》), without attributing them to shuge.org.
v1.0 article MUST NOT auto-generate historical facts. Every factual claim must have at least one citation_id OR be marked as [Limitation: unverified / not in evidence corpus].
v1.0 article MUST NOT change any Citation ID. All 6 SHUGE:p<post_id>:<page_seq> IDs preserved verbatim from v0.7.
v1.0 article MUST NOT change provenance. All provenance lines preserved from v0.7 bibliography.
v1.0 article MUST NOT acquire new resources. No new downloads, no OCR runs, no new DB queries.
